note: Single source for how each data feed and each scheduled task reaches the repo: route, cadence, how lateness is detected and the fallback. RUNBOOK, CURRENT-STATE and the task prompts point here instead of restating routes. A PR that changes a route edits this file in the same PR (PR template checkbox). Reference data, not coaching instructions.

paths.route: GitHub Actions pull-garmin.yml: four cron pulls a day (UTC 10:23, 11:23, 16:23, 23:23) that in practice land 5 to 10 h late (Oct 23 to Nov 3, 2026), plus the morning check-in's own workflow_dispatch, which lands in about a minute
paths.fallback: dispatch again once; if nothing lands, the check-in runs on the data on hand and says so (RUNBOOK Data 2 and 3)

paths.what: Hume scale weight and body fat % (lean mass Calculated)
paths.route: Hume app writes Apple Health; iPhone Shortcut 'Send scale to coach' runs on its own from personal automations at 9:00 AM and 8:00 PM (built and working Nov 3, 2026), repository_dispatch body_comp, ingest-body-comp.yml
paths.cadence: twice daily send; weigh-ins when the athlete steps on the scale
paths.late_means: no new weigh-in has reached the repo in 48 h: either no weigh-in (travel) or the Shortcut stopped (received_utc moves only when a value changes, so a send with nothing new leaves no trace)
paths.fallback: weigh in, then if nothing lands by the next automation, open the Shortcut once by hand; the manual send from a Claude chat on the iPhone (coach/ops/APPLE-HEALTH-SEND.md) is the last resort

paths.what: Daily Fitness Coach check-in (scheduled task outside the project, 7:45 AM ET)
paths.route: scheduled task (task id), prompt coach/ops/TASK-PROMPT-morning.md, steps coach/ops/RUNBOOK.md
paths.fallback: the next run notices a missing day and says so in its last line

paths.what: Race calendar watch (project routine, Sundays 5:27 AM ET, silent)
paths.route: project scheduled task (task id) (recreated Nov 5, 2026); its prompt reads coach/ops/TASK-PROMPT-weekly.md from the repo at each run, so edit that file, not the task. The Oct 19 task (task id) is switched off (its stored text had drifted from the file)
paths.fallback: run the task by hand from the Coach project

paths.what: Monthly research scan (project routine, 1st of the month 4:53 AM ET, silent)
paths.route: scheduled task (task id), prompt coach/ops/TASK-PROMPT-research.md, method coach/research/PROTOCOL.md
paths.fallback: run the task by hand from the Coach project

paths.what: Morning feel answers (dashboard form or chat)
paths.route: dashboard store feel_daily, copied by the morning run (RUNBOOK Data 4)
dashboard store lift_log, ingested by lifts.py in the morning run
dashboard store checkin, ingested by checkins.py in the morning run

paths.what: Home blood pressure readings (A&D cuff photos)
paths.route: the athlete posts cuff photos in the Coach project with no text; the receiving thread logs them by the rules in coach/ops/HOME-BP.md without asking, via a small PR
writes: coach/health.json (lab bp_sys / bp_dia rows with time and part)
paths.fallback: the twice-yearly home BP week survey on the Check-ins tab

paths.what: Block brief decision (Fitness tab, This block card, Next option)
paths.route: dashboard store brief_choice, recorded by brief.py accept or change in the morning run (RUNBOOK Data 4)
paths.cadence: once per block, while a brief is proposed
paths.fallback: unanswered by decide_by, the brief goes live as proposed (engine/BLOCK-BRIEF.md section 2)

consumers_outside_repo: Sunday mentor review task ((task id)) reads coach.json rows today, week, marker from the dashboard store: a coach.json schema change must keep those rows
Gmail triage task ((task id)) watches race registration mail; it does not write to the repo
Used bike deal watch ((task id)) writes coach/bike-watch.md only
